limitations: Terrain colour uses existing Earth imagery; this is not street-level imagery or a buildings/airport simulation.
Stellar catalogue coordinates remain fixed: no new per-star proper motion or annual parallax propagation.
Ground altitude shares DEM datum with local geometry; geoid correction interface currently uses N=0.
Online geographic search, every geography/altitude combination, prolonged memory stress, and offline cold-start are not comprehensively browser-tested in this batch.
Aircraft and rocket surface dynamics are outside this implementation.
